title: Bank Deposit Returned Payments: Attribution Table, Decision Windows and Resend Charges
content:
When a beneficiary bank sends a Bank Deposit payment back, the tier's return terms decide who the return reason is attributed to, how long the customer has to decide, what the bank's handling fee is, at what margin the returned currency is converted back to US dollars, and what it costs to send the transfer again.

## Attribution of return reasons (identical on all six tiers)

| Return reason reported by the beneficiary bank | Attributed to |
|---|---|
| Invalid account number | the sender |
| Account closed | the sender |
| Name mismatch | the sender |
| Account frozen | the sender |
| Account type mismatch | the sender |
| Recalled at the sender's request | the sender |
| Currency not accepted | Paloma's side |
| Partner processing error | Paloma's side |
| Duplicate payment | Paloma's side |

## Figures by tier

| Tier | Decision window (calendar days after the funds come back) | Beneficiary bank handling fee on a sender-side return (USD) | Conversion-back margin (percent below mid-market) | Resend fee (USD) | Sender-side resends free of the resend fee | Most resends on one transfer |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bank Deposit Economy | 30 | 0.00 | 0.50 | 4.99 | 0 | 2 |
| Bank Deposit Standard | 30 | 0.00 | 0.50 | 4.99 | 0 | 2 |
| Bank Deposit Express | 30 | 0.00 | 0.50 | 2.99 | 1 | 2 |
| Bank Deposit Express Plus | 30 | 0.00 | 0.50 | 0.00 | 1 | 3 |
| Bank Deposit Large Amount | 45 | 15.00 | 0.35 | 9.99 | 0 | 2 |
| Bank Deposit International Wire | 60 | 30.00 | 0.50 | 25.00 | 0 | 1 |

**Recipient details that may be corrected on a returned transfer (all tiers):** the beneficiary name, the beneficiary bank name and the beneficiary account number.

## Definitions

- **Decision window.** The calendar days after funds come back within which the customer may have the transfer sent again; after that it is refunded.
- **Handling fee.** The fee a beneficiary bank charges on a sender-attributable return, deducted from the refund.
- **Conversion-back margin.** The margin below the mid-market rate at which returned foreign currency is converted back to US dollars.
- **Resend fee.** The fee for sending a returned transfer again after a sender-attributable return; the stated number of sender-side resends on one transfer are free of it.
- **Most resends.** The largest number of times one transfer may be sent again after returns; beyond it the transfer must be refunded.
